title: identifiers are ASCII only
purpose: Invalid source is rejected before execution.

rejection.justification: A character outside the token set may be reported by the lexer or as a parse error.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: grammar: BINDING_NAME = [a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*; a non-ASCII letter is not an identifier character.
